stem:
Rehan studies a quadrilateral whose four sides are equal. Right angles are not required.

Which claim correctly classifies this quadrilateral?

options.text: It is a rhombus even when the four sides are not equal.
Being a parallelogram is what forces all four sides to be equal.
It is a rhombus because all sides are equal, and every rhombus is a parallelogram.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal sides define a rhombus; every rhombus is a parallelogram. Dropping the equal-sides condition, reversing parallelogram→equal sides, or calling every parallelogram a rhombus all miss the classification hinge.
